title: Summer Wind | KEY.co
description_expanded: Within its gracious confines, Summer Wind marries the essence of coastal elegance with the pinnacle of luxury living. The heart of the home, an open-concept kitchen and living area, is outfitted with premium appliances and expansive seating, setting the stage for memorable entertainment and culinary delights. Beyond its interior allure, the property boasts a myriad of outdoor amenities designed to elevate the vacation experience. Highlights include a sprawling sun deck crowned with cypress trusses, a lavish pool and hot tub ensemble complete with a custom waterfall feature, and an exclusive outdoor grill area, all ensconced within a sophisticated brick and masonry enclosure. Adding to the allure, a six-seater golf cart and bikes are at your disposal, inviting exploration of the charming surroundings and the nearby idyllic town of Seaside with utmost ease and style. Nestled in the vibrant heart of Seagrove and a stone's throw from the pristine, sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast, Summer Wind emerges as a haven of luxury and tranquility. This exquisite seven-bedroom, seven-bath residence offers a sanctuary for up to 24 guests, ensuring ample space for relaxation and joyous gatherings. Spanning nearly 6,000 square feet of elegantly appointed heated and cooled interiors, the home unfolds over four meticulously designed levels. Each floor welcomes an open-concept common area that seamlessly extends into oversized outdoor porches, while the upper stories present breathtaking Gulf views that promise to captivate and enchant.
